purpose: Audit that the NEXT3 design retains the methodological work required to discriminate the Q1-Q5 dimensions inherited from NEXT2, before exploratory scientific fixture generation.

coverage.question: Q1
coverage.design_control: Semantic future-space profiles are explicit pre-decision observable representations; balanced reassignment f breaks action-identity/future-representation equivalence.

coverage.question: Q2
coverage.design_control: Four presentation strata (order, position, orientation, neutral format) are crossed with action identity and future assignment.

coverage.question: Q3
coverage.design_control: UNINFORMATIVE_NULL removes the action-to-future informational correspondence while preserving the same profile vocabulary and comparable surface complexity; condition labels are hidden.

coverage.question: Q4
coverage.design_control: Four domains and five operationalisations are retained, with deterministic structural semantics and semantic-completeness checks.

coverage.question: Q5
coverage.design_control: Primary estimand is action_identity × future_representation_assignment interaction on selection probability; primary contrast is informative versus matched uninformative null under balanced reassignment.

boundary_controls.evidence: S_t and task_context are now frozen and serialized after the specification-gap correction and binding preflight.
z, realized successor, realized transformation and realized T_acc remain post-decision.
Profiles contain structural dimensions only; no value/reward/performance signal.
Simulator binding, parity and semantic-completeness gates passed.
NEXT3 remains a separate experiment and the design explicitly prohibits pooling for mechanism inference.

replication_parameter_decision.basis: Exploratory execution authorization explicitly fixes three complete repetitions; 30 has no independent pre-execution statistical justification and must not be treated as the scientific replication count.
